name: smith good morning off pins
description: A good morning on the Smith machine starting from the pins. It builds the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Set the bar on the pins at upper-chest height and duck under it.
Stand tall with the bar on your upper back and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is near parallel with the floor.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then return the bar to the pins when done.
